title: Fill density 2.5 lines/mm: rows 1/density apart, edge to edge
description: A 40 × 40 mm fill at 0°, under sewing off, density 2.5: the rows lie 1/density apart with the first and the last row on the outline, as in PE-DESIGN's file.

evidence.note: Fill Stitch: Density, Pull compensation, Under sewing

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 40 mm square with the Rectangle tool from (10, 10) to (50, 50) mm. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Fill Stitch, Direction Manual 0°, Under sewing unticked, Density 2.5, every other region attribute at PE-DESIGN's default (Density 4.5, Step pitch 4.0 mm, Frequency 30 %, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Feathered edge and Gradation off). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN's rows are 1/density apart, the first and the last on the edges (101 rows for 40 mm)
rows run from edge to edge (pull compensation 0)
PE-DESIGN's count; OpenStitch differs in the row ends, entry travel and locks (stitch-rules F3)

PE-DESIGN 11.50's file, needle point for needle point (±0.15 mm): the row order in halves from the start point, the out-and-back first row, brick row ends, straight ≤ 2 mm travel, Frequency grid from the bounding box and the 0.3 mm tie-in and lock (stitch-rules F3/F6)
